title: Be registered to carry out certification work
what: Be registered, for the class of work, before carrying out building and development certification work.

sources.title: Building and Development Certifiers Act 2018 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: (1) A person must not carry out certification work unless— (a) the person is registered and the registration authorises the person to carry out the certification work,
